video_index_rule: V = 5 * condition_index + view_index + 1; V01-V05 low, V06-V10 rated, V11-V15 stress
assembly_id_rule: T-C-NNN-Pnn; NNN is unique inside each class; Pnn identifies the assigned hardware recipe, not extra counted assemblies
split_rule: 80/10/10 percent by assembly within each category; all 15 views/conditions of an assembly remain in the same split

physics.model_authority: MuJoCo trajectories; Blender replays exported body transforms

data_contract.actions: Log controller commands and realized actuator forces separately; feedback-derived future torques are not silently included as planned actions

quality_gates: Distinct physical geometry/structure; camera, color or file-name changes do not count as new assemblies
SI part dimensions, mating datums, clearances, rigid-body ownership, mass, COM and inertia
Complete frame/joint graph and constraint-rank independent DOF audit
Positive masses/inertias, reachable motion, no unintended interpenetration or solver divergence
Independent mechanism-specific geometric and dynamic equations, and work-energy audit with explicit contact/compliance terms
Three independently simulated conditions, five calibrated views per condition
Blender part poses agree with exported physics transforms at all rendered frames
Decoded video dimensions, fps, frame count, finite state metadata and complete lineage
Per-template visual inspection before releasing a production batch
naming_policy: S = planar/2.5D; H = spatial closed-chain/parallel. Unimplemented original categories are archival plans, not active data.
